scientific_reading: QP092B connects closed matter writes to the unresolved QP092A tensor carrier through the existing qA source ledger. qA source support splits into 7/8 retained write support and 1/8 carrier support with no new parameter, but direct qA-as-mass is rejected because it overreads A. The accepted A_environment update comes after compression back to the post-bounce mass ledger, preserving force/clock/road readout while keeping the carrier out of the particle table.
